PlainTicker app icon — eight ideas, attempt three

Eight different ideas, not eight weights of one. Each is drawn from primitive shapes, each is shown flattened to one colour because the themed icon and the notification silhouette have no colour to lean on, and each is composited into the real app drawer, in the tile PlainTicker occupies on the attached Seeker, under the launcher's own measured mask.

Nothing here is ranked and nothing is recommended. The last two attempts handed over a conclusion instead of a choice, and both were rejected on sight. The order is the order they were drawn in. Judge them in the drawer strip first, with the captions hidden if you like: a mark that needs its explanation has already lost.
